name: 27551-gsm8kdllm-llada2mini-1gpu
model: inclusionAI/LLaDA2.0-mini, a diffusion language model. bf16, ~32.5 GB over 7 safetensors shards, ungated. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE: the engine's diffusion path accepts only the architectures in its fixed table and raises on anything else.
parallelism: tp1 on one card. EP=1, PP=1, no router, no external cache tier, no disaggregation.
architecture: LLaDA2MoeModelLM: 20 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, sparse MoE of 256 routed experts top-8 plus 1 shared, ~16 B total against ~1.4 B active, bf16, no quantization; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, bounded at 1000 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed 42, first 10% of the run discarded as warmup.
workload: Five-shot GSM8K, a real dataset shipped with the item as configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-1000.jsonl. 1000 rows, one turn each, no chat template, raw text to /v1/completions; prompts measure 865.3 tokens mean against this checkpoint's tokenizer (sd 21.3, min 828, max 946). Generation is temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512 and three stop strings, with output length unpinned and typically near ~124 tokens.
purpose: A grade-school math tutor solving worked word problems with a 16-billion-parameter diffusion model, 16 concurrent streams, one GPU.
launch:
model-path: inclusionAI/LLaDA2.0-mini

# The checkpoint carries its own modelling code. Required to load it at all.
trust-remote-code: true

max-running-requests: 4
mem-fraction-static: 0.9
attention-backend: flashinfer
dllm-algorithm: LowConfidence

# `cuda-graph-bs-decode` is the decode-phase key at this commit. `--cuda-graph-bs` is a deprecated
# alias here: argparse still accepts it and forwards it to this field, but it is no longer a
# `ServerArgs` member. There is no prefill-phase list.
cuda-graph-bs-decode: [1, 2, 3, 4]
